info.title: NIF Abstractor API
info.description: Backend API for building source-to-Kafka/NiFi flows. Authentication is intentionally disabled for the current MVP test environment. Use this Swagger UI to manually create connections, sources, flows, schemas, test streams, deploy flows, inspect Kafka messages, and run schema inference.

post.description: Create a NiFi, Kafka, or Apicurio connection. Secrets are accepted but never returned directly.

get.summary: List live NiFi controller service types

post.summary: Create a NiFi global controller service

get.summary: Get live NiFi global service config

post.summary: Mark a NiFi global service as default

get.description: Return a list of flows with name, state, and topic for the dashboard panel.

post.description: Create a REST API, MongoDB, SMB, or PostgreSQL source definition with one or more streams.

put.description: Fully replace a source definition. Use the same payload shape as create source.

post.description: Run a read-only stream test and return response/file/document preview data. Use parent_values when the stream depends on a parent stream value.
Create an Avro schema artifact with initial draft version 1.

put.description: Update the Avro schema content of a specific version.

post.description: Mark a version as Needs Verification (after generation).
Validate the Avro schema and register it with Apicurio when a registry connection exists.
Create a flow record linked to an existing source. Kafka topic is derived from source name and primary stream.

put.description: Full update of a flow. Used by Flow Designer when editing an existing flow.

patch.description: Enable/disable a flow, update schema links, store schema inference job ID, or normalize Draft/Stopped state.

delete.description: Delete a flow record and remove its associated NiFi process group.

post.description: Start a flow — checks eligibility, then starts via NiFi API.

Deploy a configured source as a NiFi flow.

Idempotency: if the flow is already in 'Deploying' state, returns 409 to prevent duplicates.
Delete the linked NiFi process group for a flow without deleting the flow itself.

get.description: List all NiFi controller services for a deployed flow, with full component details.
List all live NiFi processors for a deployed flow.
Fetch full live NiFi configuration for a specific processor.

put.description: Update a live NiFi processor's dynamic properties.

get.description: Fetch full configuration and property descriptors for a specific NiFi controller service.

put.description:
Update a NiFi controller service's properties.

Handles the disable → update → re-enable cycle required by NiFi.

post.summary: Preview a flowpack import without writing records
Validate re-entered flowpack credentials without importing
Import a validated flowpack as a new draft flow

post.description: Deploy a temporary inference flow, collect Kafka samples, infer an Avro schema, and save it as Needs Verification.

get.description: Get the most recent schema inference job for a flow.

post.description:
Accept the generated schema from an inference job.
- Schema is already saved as 'Needs Verification' (done in the background runner)
- Links the schema to the flow if not already linked
- Deletes the inference NiFi process group
- Returns the schema_artifact_id and schema_version for navigation

post.summary: Upload and parse an OpenAPI document
Attach OpenAPI spec to a source

delete.summary: Detach OpenAPI spec from a source
